about: Client projectile object (class with virtual table, stored inline). Born when spells/throws were used (with ecl::projectile::Attachment/Spell/ImpactEvent, jump events). Names from Toolkit accessors of ecl::Projectile and its copy constructors EoCClient.dll+0x2951F0 / +0x295400, whose layout ends at 0x23A (padded 0x240 = registry size 576).

evidence.says: copy ctor EoCClient.dll+0x2951F0 sets *(this) = ecl::Projectile::vftable (base ls::ITextKeyEventHandler). Live: module pointer.
copied as 8 bytes by the copy ctor; live equals the handle in EntityRef (+0x30) - the projectile entity.
copied as 8 bytes; live always 0.
Toolkit accessor get/set Template (ls::GameObjectTemplate const*) at +0x18. Live heap pointer.
copy ctor EoCClient.dll+0x295400 copies +0x20..+0x2C as ls::DynamicArray of ls::TypeWrap<int, net::PeerIDClassname> (IndexedStorage assert), element 4 bytes. Live capacity 2.
Toolkit accessor ref EntityRef (ecs::EntityRef, 16 bytes: handle + world) at +0x30; this is its handle. Live entity handles.
second half of the EntityRef accessor at +0x30 (EntityWorld pointer). Live heap pointer.
Toolkit accessor set SourceWeapon at +0x40. Live null.
Toolkit accessor ref Path (eoc::PathMover) at +0x48, size 0x128 (next member at +0x170); same type as SE path::PathMover (ExposedTypes.h) - kept opaque because only primitive types may be used here.

ecl::Projectile::TryExplode (EoCClient.dll+0x921AF0): 'LevelManager::GetLevel(this + 0x170)' and copies it as the level of temp sound events. | first pass: copy ctor copies it with ls::FixedString::FixedString.

Toolkit accessor ref SpellID (eoc::spell::SpellId) at +0x178, 0x38 bytes (next member +0x1B0).

Server pair: Toolkit accessors SpawnEffect (+0x518) / SpawnOverridesImpact (+0x51C). | first pass: copy ctor copies it as FixedString. Live always empty (0xFFFFFFFF).

Toolkit accessor set Source at +0x1C8.

ecl::Projectile::SetMovingObject(IGameObject*, bool) (EoCClient.dll+0x921200) works on +0x1D0; TryExplode (EoCClient.dll+0x921AF0) looks it up as Item / Character; Update waits for it to be activated. Name as esv::Projectile::MovingObject. | first pass: copied as 8 bytes; live entity handles or null.

Update (EoCClient.dll+0x923540) clears it when the entity is dead. | first pass: copied as 8 bytes; live always null (0xFFC0000000000000).
Toolkit accessor ref MovingObjectTransform (ls::Transform, 40 bytes) at +0x1E0. Live scale +0x200/+0x204 = 1.0.
copied 8+4 bytes at +0x208/+0x210 right before TargetPosition; live world-coordinate-like floats (cf. esv::Projectile SourcePos).
Toolkit accessor ref TargetPosition (Vector3f) at +0x214.
Toolkit accessor set LifeTime at +0x220. Live 9.2/10/20.

Thrown entity has never been activated!' and requests deletion. Same name and default (15.0) as esv::Projectile::FallbackTimer in Script Extender. | first pass: copied as 4 bytes; live 14.11/15.0 (esv::Projectile has FallbackTimer 15.0 - possibly the same).

SetMovingObject stores its bool argument here (EoCClient.dll+0x921200: 'this[0x238] = param_2'); the server's esv::Projectile::SetMovingObject (EoCServer.dll+0x80CF40) stores the same argument at +0x52C, which lies between the Toolkit accessors IsTrap (+0x52B) and MoveFromSource (+0x52D) = IsThrown in Script Extender's esv::Projectile. | first pass: copied as a byte.

ecl::Projectile::Update (EoCClient.dll+0x923540): on the first update it is 0 and is set to 1 without calling PathMover::Update; later updates advance Path. Constructor 0. | first pass: copied as a byte.

ecl::Projectile::Update (EoCClient.dll+0x923540): while 0 it is set to 1 once MovingObject is valid and passes FUN_1805f66e0; the path only advances when MovingObject is null or this is set (the fallback timer catches the case where it never happens). | first pass: copied as a byte (last member copied).
